steps.npc: Very good, my child. My disciples are providing a steady supply of their blood for the vampyres. As promised, the tithing of humans has been completely outlawed.

steps.player: And the vampyres are all happy with that?

steps.npc: Most are understanding of the fact that regardless of anything else, the days of tithing humans were running short. However, it is true that some found human blood to be more... appetising.

steps.player: I assume that won't be a problem?

steps.npc: You need not fear, my child. Any that attempt to take blood from a human will be dealt with harshly.

That said, my understanding is that some humans did willingly provide their blood to the Drakans. It is of course possible that could be explored again in future, albeit with very different arrangements.
However, I very much understand that will likely be a... difficult proposal for most to swallow.

steps.player: Yes, I can't see many being up for that sort of thing. Speaking of which, how are the humans of Morytania doing?

steps.npc: The fact that they are not being tithed is on its own a significant improvement to their quality of life. However, their homes are still ruins and these lands are still dangerous.
We are offering our help in building them new homes, but it will take many years, and most are still naturally distrusting of our kind.

steps.player: I'm guessing a lot will be more interested in starting new lives across the Salve.

steps.npc: You are correct, my child. However, while we have established somewhat of an... understanding with your human kingdoms to the west, it is their preference that we try to limit how many humans relocate over there.

They are not equipped to deal with a large number of refugees, and it is also our hope that many humans will realise they still have a place here. We will need their help restoring these lands to glory.

steps.player: That's not going to be an easy undertaking.

steps.npc: It will most certainly take many of your human lifetimes, but I have no doubt we will make it so.

options.text: I see you've opened a new portal to Vampyrium.

steps.player: I see you've opened a new portal to Vampyrium.

steps.npc: Yes... While my disciples are currently providing blood for the vampyres here, I do not consider that a suitable long-term solution. Haemalchemy, I believe, will be the true answer.

With us having outlawed the practice of vampyrification, we have started using the labs to explore the creation of artificial blood instead. Curiously, we've already had some luck with daeyalt of all things.
It seems that the very substance that is the key to making vampyres can also potentially contribute to feeding them. While it makes sense in many ways, it was also rather... unexpected.

steps.player: Interesting... And how does Vampyrium play into this?

steps.npc: Vampyrium is home to all manner of flora and fauna that cannot be found here. With the threat of Drakan dealt with, my disciples can freely travel to and from there, collecting samples to use in our experiments.

You are more than welcome to use the portal yourself, my child. Blood donations from Efaritay and my disciples keep it well powered, and it may be that you'll find Vampyrium to offer something of interest to you.
